title: Pod membership: per-period roster snapshots + add/remove
description: Make pod membership mutable via per-period snapshots (Option B). Replace fixed Pod.members with versioned rosters (fromPeriod => members); settlement/votes/quorum for period P use the roster in force during P. Add addMember/removeMember (admin=creator, effective next period, min 2 members). Track periodContributors explicitly so refunds go to actual contributors regardless of roster. Period-scope commit/log/vote gating. Redeploy + update MCP (membersOf(period), currentPeriod, mast_pod_add_member/remove_member) + tests + docs.

title: Redeploy V2 to Base mainnet with clean names
description: Current test deploy 0x3ad22182B7D8BaE02beEe549109F11d05547BC80 uses week-based ABI. After the rename, redeploy a fresh contract and abandon the test one. Re-run the pod smoke test against it.

title: Rename week→period throughout CommitmentEscrowV2
description: Pod period is now configurable, so week-based names are misnomers. Rename: resolveWeek→resolvePeriod, voteWeek→votePeriod, voteWeekSplit→votePeriodSplit, weekOf→periodOf, weekEnd→periodEnd, refundWeek→refundPeriod, weekResolved→periodResolved, events WeekResolved/WeekRefunded→PeriodResolved/PeriodRefunded, Pod.weekZero→periodZero, Pod.weeklyMinutes→targetMinutes. Keep 'period' for the index param, 'periodLength'/Pod.period for the duration. Update tests, smoke script, README.

title: settle.js: auto-expire overdue pod stakes
description: Members currently expire their own missed pod stakes via mast_pod_expire. Extend the nightly settle daemon to scan the V2 pod contract's Committed/Expired events (or local pods.json across members) and auto-expire overdue unsettled pod stakes so pools fund without manual action, then auto-resolve ended periods where a majority split vote exists.

title: Wire mast_pod_* MCP tools
description: Expose pod mode via MCP: mast_pod_create, mast_pod_commit, mast_pod_log_progress, mast_pod_vote, mast_pod_resolve, plus mast_set_forfeit_plan for solo forfeit routing. Blocked on final contract address after redeploy.

title: Pod messaging: Telegram/WhatsApp notify
description: Implement mast-mcp/pod-notify.js stub: notify(pod,event) fans out to configured channels for progress/expiry/resolution. Config in ~/.mast/pod-notify.json.
